landing.title: Your one-stop center for government certificates & Aadhaar services
landing.subtitle: Income certificate, community certificate, Aadhaar enrolment and more — done right, without the runaround.
landing.servicesSubtitle: Fees, processing time and documents required — all upfront.
landing.howItWorksStep1Body: Browse our services and see the exact fee and documents needed.
landing.howItWorksStep2Body: Fill in your details online — no need to visit first.
landing.howItWorksStep3Body: Get updates on WhatsApp or check anytime with your tracking code.
landing.whyUsFeeBody: See the exact fee before you start — no surprises.
landing.whyUsBilingualBody: Get help in English or Malayalam, whichever you prefer.
landing.whyUsTrackBody: Check your request status online, any time, with your tracking code.
landing.whyUsWhatsappBody: Reach us directly on WhatsApp for quick help.
landing.faqA1: Each service page lists its exact required documents — check before you start a request.
landing.faqA2: Processing time varies by service, shown on each service's page — most certificates take a few working days.
landing.faqQ3: Can I track my request online?
landing.faqA3: Yes — use the "Check Status" page with your tracking code and phone number, any time.
landing.faqA4: Yes, including new enrolment, updates/corrections, and appointment booking.
landing.faqQ5: Is the website available in Malayalam?
landing.faqA5: Yes — use the language toggle at the top of any page to switch between English and Malayalam.
